result.reason: The clause does not reach the preferred position because TrueLink may still assign without Client consent to a financially responsible affiliate, and Client’s affiliate-assignment right remains subject to the same financial-responsibility qualification. It also does not meet the fallback, which requires mutual successor-assignment rights with written notice. The competitor prohibition and protection against termination upon Client change of control are included, but adding suspension and repricing restrictions, as well as reorganization and equity-sale language, goes beyond the stated position. The drafting is generally professional, though the operative assignment language remains limited to assignment of “rights” rather than the Agreement and related obligations.
